pull_request.title: feat: implement shared budget.toml schema with validation
pull_request.body:
Closes #102

## Summary

Implements and validates the shared `budget.toml` schema that `README.md` promises — both tools share one file, but each owns its own sections.

## Changes

### Schema & validation (`cargo-cost-lint/src/main.rs`)
- **`BudgetConfig`** — root struct with **no** `deny_unknown_fields`, so foreign top-level sections (`[network]`, `[source]`, `[functions.*]`) from `soroban-budget-assert` parse without error
- **`LintsConfig`** — new struct with `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` — typos in lint names produce a clear serde error naming the offending key
- **`validate_lint_level()`** — extracted as a pure `Result<(), String>` function, testable without subprocess hacks; validates levels as `allow` | `warn` | `deny`
- Config loading now uses `unwrap_or_else` with proper error messages + exit codes (no more silent `if let Ok` swallowing parse errors)

### Tests (8 new unit tests)
- Valid lints parse correctly
- Foreign `[network]`, `[source]`, `[functions.*]` sections coexist cleanly
- Unknown lint name produces an error containing the offending key
- Missing / empty `[lints]` section parses as `None`
- Valid levels (`allow`, `warn`, `deny`) accepted
- Invalid level produces descriptive error

### Fixture (`test_fixtures/smoke_test/budget.toml`)
- Fixed from `[budget]` wrapper to proper `[lints]` schema
- Includes `[network]`, `[source]`, `[functions.example]` to demonstrate coexistence

### Docs (`docs/integration.md`)
- Documented the full shared schema with section ownership table
- Added `[network]`, `[source]`, `[functions.*]` sections to the code example

feat: implement shared budget.toml schema with validation (#102)

- Add LintsConfig struct with #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] to reject
  unknown lint names at parse time, while BudgetConfig root leaves
  foreign top-level sections (network, source, functions.*) untouched
  for soroban-budget-assert coexistence
- Extract validate_lint_level() as pure Result-returning function for
  testability; validate severity as "allow"|"warn"|"deny"
- Replace silent if-let-Ok config parsing with unwrap_or_else that
  prints errors and exits
- Add 8 unit tests: valid lints, foreign section coexistence, unknown
  lint name rejection, empty/missing lints section, level validation
- Update test_fixtures/smoke_test/budget.toml to proper [lints] schema
  with soroban-budget-assert sections (network, source, functions.*)
- Document the full shared budget.toml schema and section ownership
  table in docs/integration.md

Closes #102
